full_name_ar: عبد الله بن عمرو بن الحارث بن أبي ضرار

bio: Ibn Hibban's al-Thiqat lists Abdullah ibn Umayra ibn Hisn al-Qaysi of Banu Qays ibn Tha'laba. Al-Bukhari's al-Tarikh al-Kabir (as Ibn Husayn) says he heard Hudhayfa, and the page names him as Kufan with Simak ibn Harb narrating from him. Ibn al-Athir's Usd al-Ghaba says he lived in the Jahiliyya (he was the guide of the poet al-A'sha) but his companionship is not established.
